Subject: Polaris Tech — demo request via pricing page

Hi —

I just used the pricing page CTA and asked to schedule a demo. We're particularly interested in cost/latency tradeoffs for batch embedding pipelines and how Redwood's caching/batching would slot into our existing Spark-based ingestion. Brief context: Polaris Tech is a SaaS analytics provider processing ~60M events/month; initial POC would be ~2–3M embeddings/day.

Can we do a 30-minute walkthrough next week? Prefer afternoons PST. I've attached a short requirements doc.

Attachments: polaris_poc_requirements.pdf (PDF, 210KB)

Thanks,
Sam

• Tue Feb 16 — 11:00am or 3:00pm
• Wed Feb 17 — 1:00pm or 4:00pm
